decisionsTitle: The Excel export: «Status» right after the race number, as a drop-down list (amending §790 and §172)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-16, from his phone:** «In the excel export the status should come right after BIB and it should be a select, not free text». **Amends §790** (the live Excel) and **§172** (the start list as a spreadsheet, its columns in `workbook.ts`).

**Where.** «Status» is the third column of the spreadsheet, between «Race number (BIB)» and «Name». It was far to the right, beside «Until when» and «Waiting on» (§650); those two stay where they were, so every other column keeps its place relative to the others. **The CSV is untouched:** its order is read by position by the club's scripts (§425, §664), and a test holds its header byte for byte. Nothing in the formulas or the colour rules named a letter: the statistics ranges (`workbook.ts`, `range("Status")`) and the conditional-formatting rules (`sheet-colours.ts`, `statusColumn`) were both derived from the header's index, so the move changed the letter from `M` to `C` and nothing else. A test now builds files of one event, of several and with the notes column, and asserts that every formula range and every rule reads the letter the header gives «Status», so a later reorder cannot break the counts silently.

**A drop-down, not free text.** The data rows of the column carry a list data validation (`<dataValidation type="list" allowBlank="0" showErrorMessage="1">` over `C2:C<last registration>`, the stop style, `showDropDown` left out because in the file format that attribute HIDES the arrow). Offline, the club picks a state from the list instead of typing one, so the footer's `COUNTIF`s and the row colours, which count exact words, can never be missed by a typo or a translation. The list is `registrationStatus.enumValues`, in the order the backoffice's filter lists them — the one source `STATUS_TINT`, the statistics and the legend already agree with (a test holds them together) — and rides inline in the rule (`"A,B,C"`), 102 characters against Excel's 255; `writeSheet` refuses a list longer than 255 or with a comma in a word instead of writing a rule Excel would repair. The header, the empty row and the whole footer are outside the range; a file with no registrations has none. The error box says «Alege o stare din listă.» / "Pick a status from the list." in the reader's language (`Admin.registrations.sheetpick`), under the title «Stare nepermisă» / "Status not allowed". Words, not tokens in the list: the cells keep the status token (`CONFIRMED`), as the filter, the CSV and the formulas already say it — a translated list would not match the cells.

**How it is written.** `write-excel-file` has no data-validation option, so the existing post-processing next to the formulas' cached values (`liveFormulas`, now `sheetExtras`) writes the `<dataValidations>` block into `xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml` where `CT_Worksheet` wants it: after `conditionalFormatting`, before `hyperlinks`, `printOptions`, `pageMargins` and the rest (the writer emits none of them today, so it lands before `</worksheet>`). `buildRegistrationsWorkbook` takes `statusPick` (the two words) and the export route passes it; a caller that passes none gets plain text cells, as before. The sponsor sheet is untouched and its test now asserts it has no data validation either.

**Refused.** Moving «Until when» and «Waiting on» along with «Status» (the brief moved one column; the owner may want the three together — his call); a hidden helper sheet for the list (it fits inline); a translated list; a different column order in the CSV; a new dependency; a migration.

**Tests.** `registrations/excel-live.test.ts` (new describe): the header's third cell, the other columns' relative order, the CSV header unchanged, the ranges and rules at the header's letter in three shapes of file, the validation over exactly the data rows with the words, the position and the absence of `showDropDown`, the error words in both languages and their escaping, the refusals, no validation for no rows or no words, nothing else changed in the bytes, an edit that picks another state; and the sponsor sheet. `row-deadline.test.ts` no longer says the deadline pair sits right after «Status». The file also loads in openpyxl with the validation readable. **Consequences.** `registrations/workbook.ts`, the export route, `messages/{ro,en}.json` (`Admin.registrations.sheetpick`), `docs/VIBECODING.md`. No migration, no dependency.
changelogLine: - **The Excel export: «Status» right after the race number, as a drop-down list** — pick a state from the list instead of typing one, so the statistics and the row colours always count it; the CSV keeps its order. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criterion 159. Given the registrations export in Excel, when it is downloaded, then «Status» is the third column, right after «Race number (BIB)», and its data rows (not the header, not the footer) are a drop-down list of every registration state that refuses any other word, with the error message in the list's language; the statistics' formulas and the colour rules read the column at the letter the header gives it; the CSV's columns keep their order (2026-10-16, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
